name: Runner Tests Fixture - Page Rowset Triggers
brief: Issue #3439: TestPage navigation must go through the page's own OnFindRecord/OnNextRecord when it declares them, and through the platform when it does not.
description: Runner-mechanism fixture. What BC does is settled upstream by corpus codeunits 60679 and 60680 (StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests#275), measured on a real 28.4 service tier; this fixture pins the runner's OWN dispatch so a regression fails loudly here without the submodule pin having to be bumped first, and pins the two arms the corpus cannot reach: which Which/Steps values the runner passes, and that a page declaring NEITHER trigger raises neither. Declares no application floor: everything it needs is its own.
